scope: Silent visual commentary matching the earlier crawl demo. Six independent original JP ROM supplied-state replays: three vertical handoffs and three horizontal comparisons. segments.title: VPU crawl, slides and walking
segments.tag: INK HANDOFF / SIX INDEPENDENT JP ROM TESTS
lines: Three supplied vertical tests reach a useful Area 2 entry.
Horizontal tests show why repeating terrain queries are not enough.
segments.footer: Original JP ROM footage with explicit setup edits; explanatory diagrams are not game footage. No complete route is claimed.
segments.badge: Silent visual commentary / pauses and slow motion

segments.title: A VPU repeats queries, not the whole world
segments.tag: READING THE DIAGRAM / M, C AND D ARE DIFFERENT STORES
lines: Here, VPU means +65536 in Y: actual height 67277 queries as 1741.
The floor still returns a local height. The real warp and top stay below.
segments.footer: D means stored graphics position; the floor-alignment matrix can draw Mario elsewhere. Broken axis, not to scale.
segments.badge: Native frame before the supplied high cut

segments.title: Start with a high crawler and a high box
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: Supply Mario at (-1950, 67277, -939), already crawling, speed 5.
Supply the Crazy Box at (-1989, 67277, -939), beside him; top phase 130.
segments.footer: Supplied-state original-ROM replay. High entry and Crazy Box delivery are not controller-reachable demonstrations.
segments.badge: Diagram shows the supplied pose before input 6

segments.title: The first lookup remembers the low pad
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: At Mario's initial X/Z, the high floor query aliases to Y 1741.
It refreshes the cached floor to the actual low pad at Y 768.
segments.footer: Right: JP source + Wafel within-update explanation. Left: recorded ROM end state.
segments.badge: Input 6 end state / diagram expands that update

segments.title: The box moves M sideways while M stays high
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: The box interaction pushes movement X from -1950 to -1882.
Movement Y remains 67277. The cached floor still remembers 768.
segments.footer: Right: JP source + Wafel within-update explanation. Left: recorded ROM end state.
segments.badge: No new input between these explanatory stages

segments.title: The high quarter-step stops before installing a floor
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: The proposed step finds roof 1280, but the no-ceiling value is 20000.
Raw Y 67277 + 160 reaches that value, so the old floor cache survives.
segments.footer: Right: JP source + Wafel within-update explanation. Left: recorded ROM end state.
segments.badge: Top collision is unloaded here / zero top faces

segments.title: Save high graphics, then snap movement low
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: The ground step copies high movement into stored graphics D.
Floor alignment sets M to cached Y 768; collision C then copies low M.
segments.footer: Right: JP source + Wafel within-update explanation. Left: recorded ROM end state.
segments.badge: Instantaneous assignments / not a fall through space

segments.title: The end of input 6 contains the 66509-unit split
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: M and C are (-1882, 768, -939). Stored graphics D is still at Y 67277.
Low C is near the real warp; high D is available for the next floor retry.
segments.footer: Native end-update coordinates are measured. Stock camera may not show the high stored pose; use the M/C/D diagram.
segments.badge: Native receipt: crawl / floor 768 / no platform

segments.title: Next update: low contact, high retry
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: Low C reaches the warp and permits the real top collision to load again.
The low floor lookup fails; retrying from D aliases 67277 to 1741.
segments.footer: Right: JP source + Wafel within-update explanation. Left: recorded ROM end state.
segments.badge: Top collision: zero to six faces in Wafel trace

segments.title: Warp accepted; the spinning top is captured
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: Mario disappears for the warp. Floor owner and platform both name the top.
The new floor is local Y 1818.9613, with no +65536 added.
segments.footer: Native input 7 records disappearance + top floor/platform. Local top height is not shifted by 65536.
segments.badge: Native input 7: disappeared action + top platform

segments.title: The top stays captured during the warp
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: The native recording advances while the disappearance action runs.
The right panel keeps the input 7 capture snapshot for reference.
segments.footer: Left: consecutive native inputs 7-26 at quarter speed. Right: input 7 snapshot, not current moving coordinates.

segments.title: An inactive top is still remembered
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: At input 27, the top is inactive but Mario still retains it as platform.
This stored reference survives the disappearance before Area 2 loads.
segments.footer: Native input 27 telemetry records topActive=0 and retained platform. No exactly joined screenshot exists for that input.
segments.badge: Paused at input 26 / next-update telemetry on right

segments.title: Follow the warp into Area 2
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: The transition fades, then the stock camera reaches the pyramid interior.
First Area 2 position: (365.593, 5500, -1096.803), away from normal entry.
segments.footer: Left: consecutive native inputs 30-147 at half speed. Unmapped transition frame 27 is omitted. Right: first arrival.

segments.title: Crawling reaches the useful interior side
segments.tag: 1 / 4  VPU CRAWL / INDEPENDENT SUPPLIED TEST
lines: The first Area 2 state is outside the usual elevator entry footprint.
Later native frames show Mario beside the upper interior walkway.
segments.footer: Coordinates describe first Area 2 input 30. Visible footage is later in the same independent supplied-state replay.
segments.badge: Later visible footage / coordinates at first arrival

segments.title: Replace the crawler with a ground butt slide
segments.tag: 2 / 4  VPU BUTT SLIDE / NEW INDEPENDENT REPLAY
lines: Supply the same high position and box, but ACT_BUTT_SLIDE at speed 20.
This is an established ground slide, not an airborne slide animation.
segments.footer: Supplied-state original-ROM replay. High entry and Crazy Box delivery are not controller-reachable demonstrations.
segments.badge: Native frame before the supplied high cut

segments.title: A ground bonk does not prevent this alignment
segments.tag: 2 / 4  VPU BUTT SLIDE / NEW INDEPENDENT REPLAY
lines: The stopped ground step changes the action to GROUND_BONK.
The common slide helper still aligns with the old floor after that change.
segments.footer: Right: JP source + Wafel within-update explanation. Left: recorded ROM end state.
segments.badge: Within one input / bonk then floor alignment

segments.title: The slide makes the same recorded split
segments.tag: 2 / 4  VPU BUTT SLIDE / NEW INDEPENDENT REPLAY
lines: Input 6 ends with M/C at 768 and D at 67277: a gap of 66509.
The end action is GROUND_BONK; that alone does not defeat the handoff.
segments.footer: Supplied-state original-ROM replay. High entry and Crazy Box delivery are not controller-reachable demonstrations.
segments.badge: Native receipt: ground bonk / floor 768

segments.title: The separate slide run captures the top too
segments.tag: 2 / 4  VPU BUTT SLIDE / NEW INDEPENDENT REPLAY
lines: Input 7 accepts the warp and records the spinning top as platform.
We keep following this slide replay through the actual Area 2 transition.
segments.footer: Native input 7 records disappearance + top floor/platform. Local top height is not shifted by 65536.
segments.badge: Same capture coordinates; independently recorded run

segments.title: The top stays captured during the warp
segments.tag: 2 / 4  VPU BUTT SLIDE / NEW INDEPENDENT REPLAY
lines: The native recording advances while the disappearance action runs.
The right panel keeps the input 7 capture snapshot for reference.
segments.footer: Left: consecutive native inputs 7-26 at quarter speed. Right: input 7 snapshot, not current moving coordinates.

segments.title: Follow the warp into Area 2
segments.tag: 2 / 4  VPU BUTT SLIDE / NEW INDEPENDENT REPLAY
lines: The transition fades, then the stock camera reaches the pyramid interior.
First Area 2 position: (365.593, 5500, -1096.803), away from normal entry.
segments.footer: Left: consecutive native inputs 30-147 at half speed. Unmapped transition frame 27 is omitted. Right: first arrival.

segments.title: Butt sliding also reaches the useful arrival
segments.tag: 2 / 4  VPU BUTT SLIDE / NEW INDEPENDENT REPLAY
lines: The independently recorded slide reaches the same first Area 2 position.
High slide entry and box delivery were supplied, so route reachability stays open.
segments.footer: Coordinates describe first Area 2 input 30. Visible footage is later in the same independent supplied-state replay.
segments.badge: Later visible slide-run footage

segments.title: Walking supplies the slide speed locally
segments.tag: 3 / 4  VPU WALKING TO CROUCH SLIDE / TWO SUPPLIED CUTS
lines: First supply walking on the low roof at Y 1280 and speed 20.
One native walking update initializes slide velocity, still on that low roof.
segments.footer: Preparation starts from a supplied low walking state. No climb or transport to the VPU is demonstrated.
segments.badge: Input 5 / native walking on the low roof

segments.title: A second cut moves the prepared walker high
segments.tag: 3 / 4  VPU WALKING TO CROUCH SLIDE / TWO SUPPLIED CUTS
lines: Supply high synchronized M/C/D and the high box; retain native walking speeds.
Z selects CROUCH_SLIDE; its stopped step bonks and still aligns with the floor.
segments.footer: This is walking-to-crouch-slide after a supplied high cut. Ordinary walking does not itself make the split.
segments.badge: Input 6 / second supplied relocation, then Z

segments.title: The walking-to-slide update produces the gap
segments.tag: 3 / 4  VPU WALKING TO CROUCH SLIDE / TWO SUPPLIED CUTS
lines: M/C again end at 768 while D remains at 67277; the gap is 66509.
The native end action is GROUND_BONK, just as in the butt-slide replay.
segments.footer: Supplied-state original-ROM replay. High entry and Crazy Box delivery are not controller-reachable demonstrations.
segments.badge: Native record after the Z transition

segments.title: The next update completes the same local handoff
segments.tag: 3 / 4  VPU WALKING TO CROUCH SLIDE / TWO SUPPLIED CUTS
lines: The warp is accepted and the actual spinning top becomes Mario's platform.
The run continues without another setup write after the high cut.
segments.footer: Native input 7 records disappearance + top floor/platform. Local top height is not shifted by 65536.
segments.badge: Native input 7 / top captured

segments.title: The top stays captured during the warp
segments.tag: 3 / 4  VPU WALKING TO CROUCH SLIDE / TWO SUPPLIED CUTS
lines: The native recording advances while the disappearance action runs.
The right panel keeps the input 7 capture snapshot for reference.
segments.footer: Left: consecutive native inputs 7-26 at quarter speed. Right: input 7 snapshot, not current moving coordinates.

segments.title: Follow the warp into Area 2
segments.tag: 3 / 4  VPU WALKING TO CROUCH SLIDE / TWO SUPPLIED CUTS
lines: The transition fades, then the stock camera reaches the pyramid interior.
First Area 2 position: (365.593, 5500, -1096.803), away from normal entry.
segments.footer: Left: consecutive native inputs 30-147 at half speed. Unmapped transition frame 27 is omitted. Right: first arrival.

segments.title: Walking-to-slide reaches Area 2, conditionally
segments.tag: 3 / 4  VPU WALKING TO CROUCH SLIDE / TWO SUPPLIED CUTS
lines: This third replay also reaches (365.593, 5500, -1096.803) at first arrival.
The missing route is how to obtain the supplied high pose and high box legally.
segments.footer: Coordinates describe first Area 2 input 30. Visible footage is later in the same independent supplied-state replay.
segments.badge: Later visible walking-to-slide replay footage

segments.title: Now move X by 65536 instead of Y
segments.tag: 4 / 4  HORIZONTAL PU COMPARISONS / SEPARATE FAILING TESTS
lines: The X-only tests start at (63586, 1741, -939), with the box beside Mario.
Terrain queries alias back, but Mario is far from the actual warp and top.
segments.footer: Horizontal PU means an X offset here. This finite comparison does not establish impossibility for every horizontal route.
segments.badge: Original JP ROM / X-only supplied slide

segments.title: Horizontal slide: no gap and no handoff
segments.tag: 4 / 4  HORIZONTAL PU COMPARISONS / SEPARATE FAILING TESTS
lines: The ground slide leaves the floor: M = C = D at Y 1741 after input 6.
Its floor cache is 1280; raw X remains about 63659, far from the real warp.
segments.footer: Native X-only butt-slide replay: no accepted warp, no top capture, no Area 2 handoff in the observed run.
segments.badge: Input 6 / gap 0 / no top platform

segments.title: Watch the X-only slide continue
segments.tag: 4 / 4  HORIZONTAL PU COMPARISONS / SEPARATE FAILING TESTS
lines: The remote state keeps evolving without entering the real warp.
An aliased terrain query has not returned Mario's actual X coordinate.
segments.footer: Consecutive native inputs 7-66 at half speed. Right panel explains the spatial separation, not exact changing Y.

segments.title: Horizontal walking-to-slide fails here too
segments.tag: 4 / 4  HORIZONTAL PU COMPARISONS / SEPARATE FAILING TESTS
lines: The prepared walker receives Z at the X-offset cut and becomes airborne.
Input 6 has no split: all three stores remain at Y 1741, with no top platform.
segments.footer: Native X-only walking-to-slide replay: no accepted warp, no top capture, no Area 2 handoff in the observed run.
segments.badge: Separate X-only walking-to-slide replay

segments.title: Watch the X-only walking case continue
segments.tag: 4 / 4  HORIZONTAL PU COMPARISONS / SEPARATE FAILING TESTS
lines: This separate remote run also stays away from the real warp and top.
The repeated floor coordinates are not a repeated set of interactive objects.
segments.footer: Consecutive native inputs 7-66 at half speed. Right panel is a location diagram, not an additional game camera.

segments.title: Both offsets: a huge gap can still fail
segments.tag: 4 / 4  HORIZONTAL PU COMPARISONS / SEPARATE FAILING TESTS
lines: At X +65536 and Y +65536, the slide makes the same 66509-unit Y split.
But low C is still at X 63654. Snapping Y does not move X back to the warp.
segments.footer: Supplied XY butt-slide test: M/C=(63654,768,-939), D=(63654,67277,-939) after input 6.
segments.badge: Native XY slide / gap 66509 / no warp

segments.title: On the next update, the failed split disappears
segments.tag: 4 / 4  HORIZONTAL PU COMPARISONS / SEPARATE FAILING TESTS
lines: The retry restores M/C/D to Y 67277; the new floor cache is 1280.
The real top is not captured, and no useful Area 2 arrival follows.
segments.footer: This XY failure separates a position gap from a completed handoff. Terrain aliasing alone is insufficient.
segments.badge: Native input 7 / X 63654 / no platform

segments.title: Local handoffs demonstrated; route still open
segments.tag: RESULT / CONDITIONAL SUCCESSES, NOT A COMPLETE NO-A ROUTE
lines: All three vertical supplied tests complete the handoff in original JP ROM runs.
The horizontal comparisons fail; reaching the high setup without a new A remains open.
segments.footer: Footage and end states: original JP ROM. Within-update ordering and collision-face counts: source + Wafel evidence.
segments.badge: Six replays / no A input in the recorded continuations
